annotations.title: t-test (one-sample, two-sample Welch/Student, paired) with rank-test check

description: t-test (one-sample, two-sample Welch/Student, paired) with rank-test check — Hypothesis test for means. a= comma-separated numbers (required); add b= for a two-sample test (Welch by default, equal_var=true for Student) or paired=true for a paired test; without b= it is a one-sample test against mu= (default 0). alternative=two-sided|greater|less, confidence=95. Returns t, df, p, confidence interval of the difference, Cohen d / Hedges g with magnitude, a nonparametric cross-check (Mann-Whitney U or Wilcoxon signed-rank), per-sample stats, SIGNIFICANT/NOT_SIGNIFICANT verdict and assumption notes. Offline; matches scipy. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_t_test
